hero.headline: Video consultations, written plan, follow-up.
hero.sub: Quality pediatrics and nutrition without leaving home. All consultations are held online, and the written plan arrives within 24 hours.

booking.title: Booking
booking.description: Choose a slot from the calendar and fill in a short form with the reason for your visit.

preparation.title: Preparation
preparation.description: 24h before, you receive instructions and a list of useful information (tests, food diary, etc.).

consultation.title: Consultation
consultation.description: We meet on video. Duration varies between 50–90 min depending on the type of consultation.

plan.title: Written plan
plan.description: Within 24h you receive a document with recommendations, meal plan (if applicable) and next steps.

footer.tagline: Online pediatrics and nutrition practice. Video consultations, written plan, long-term follow-up.
